decision_rule_fixed_here: SAME-FLIGHT PERCEPTION-BRANCH READ (owner decision 184; level 2; claim ceiling 'nominated', ruling O1). Per branch (a-agree delivering, b-k6p, t-twin): the sealed branch note's candidate list gives gold's rank (1/2/3/absent), top1 and present offline (gold enters only offline); the branch's level-2 first-visit Solver answer is rendered through the delivered row's normaliser and projection and scored ONCE with slurp-slu-official-train (score_complete_derived_copy); A's column is A's own first Solver answer. Every contrast is a paired ROW bootstrap (cluster key sample_id, 10,000 draws, seed 20260929); the utterance-level number is reported beside and never gates. (1) THE TWIN NULL: T minus A per metric; the bar = |T - A offset| + its CI95 half-width, reported beside the design's own provisional floor per metric (owner decision 190; stage3_measurement.provisional_floor_pp -- intent 0.6500 pp, SLU 1.4900 pp). (2) THE CONTRAST: b-k6p (key_source K6p: the centred centroid key and the centred Fold B speech queries, agreement unchanged) minus A on the level-2 branch Solver column's official intent accuracy (primary). NOMINATED iff the intent CI95 lower bound is above zero AND the point delta exceeds the twin's intent bar AND the SLU-F1 CI95 lower bound of the same column is not below minus the twin's SLU bar (guard). BRANCH-LOCAL HARM iff the intent CI95 upper bound is below zero and the point magnitude exceeds the twin bar. Otherwise NOT NOMINATED. Reported beside, never gating: gold-on-list (present) and mean gold rank of the B note vs A and T, gold at supplied-block rank 1 (the note's mechanism: +26 rows expected on Fold B), the conversion P(correct | gold rank r in the branch note) against the ledger's 97.57 / 26.98 / 12.0 %, and the delivered row (identical by construction). A nomination sends the composed policy to a full-system cross-flight read against an in-chain A/A; it admits nothing.
development_numbers_only: Every number is a TRAIN Fold B development number (owner decisions 28 and 86), never a test claim.
failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration; a second failure closes the cell and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run. The budget is run-cumulative across attempts.
one_factor: branch b-k6p: key_source k6p (centred centroid key + centred Fold B speech queries; agreement unchanged); the Fold B re-target and the program switch to phase-native-candidates-review-revise-pbranch3-l2-v1 are the instrument's carrier, shared by every branch
prohibitions: No test-split, DEV or Fold A contact or read (Fold A is the tuning roster and is not re-flown).
No re-flying of the sealed AGREE arm.
No second factor: one axis on the B branch, none on A or T.
No flight before root mints the decision receipt and the cells are flipped.
No branch score opened before the READ row is root countersigned.
No system-level claim: a branch effect may only nominate (ruling O1).
No branch value built from Fold B rollouts (owner decision 186).
